hard_case: Measured defect (#7931): ripr reported the related test's oracle `assert_eq!(score(2).ne(&0), true)` as exact_value / strong, because the method spelling of the inequality was not read as a comparison. RIPR-SPEC-0231 rule 1 (example 32): `score(2).ne(&0)` compared with `true` asserts only that inequality, so it pins no value. The line verdict stays gap; the overclaim showed in the related test's reported oracle. Since #7931's fix ripr reports relational_check / weak.
